scope: UI visual concepts, not anatomy validation or 3D model generation
desktop:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one large, exceptionally polished full-screen desktop interface design, landscape 16:10, 1920x1200 preferred, for HumanScope, a Vietnamese human anatomy exploration web application. This is a complete primary workspace screenshot, not a landing page, not a dashboard with statistic cards. Exact visual direction: HunpeoLabs / Satsunic design family: paper white #FFFFFF UI panels, cool very light gray #F5F6F9, royal blue #163CFF for primary action/selection, deep navy #111C35 text, thin #D9DCE4 borders, Inter-like sans supporting Vietnamese. Compact orderly enterprise controls with 6px radii, elegant ample space in model canvas. No decorative gradients, giant pills, teal hospital branding, green sidebar, holograms, science-fiction HUD, browser frame or device mockup.
Composition: 56px white top navigation across full width: simple blue geometric H icon + HumanScope wordmark left, links "Khám phá" (active blue underline), "Kiến thức", "Cơ sở y tế", "Học tập". Right "VI" and "Đăng nhập". Below a thin white context row: segmented modes "Khám phá", "Học tập", "Giảng dạy"; breadcrumb "Cơ thể / Hệ tuần hoàn". Main workspace left white sidebar 250px, center charcoal #151619 canvas about 1050px wide and full height, right white inspector 330px.
Left sidebar: header "Cấu trúc", persistent search label "Tìm cấu trúc", input example "Tim"; sample selector "Cơ thể trưởng thành"; "Hệ cơ quan" tidy list rows with small outline anatomical category icons and switches: "Da" off, "Cơ" off, "Xương" on, "Tuần hoàn" selected blue and on, "Hô hấp" on, "Tiêu hóa" off, "Thần kinh" off. Selected system expands short indented tree "Tim", "Động mạch", "Tĩnh mạch"; Tim selected light-blue row with blue left line. Bottom separated control "Độ trong suốt" with 35% and blue slider.
Center: a beautifully rendered, believable realistic adult anatomical full-body educational model, front three-quarter view, natural human proportions, neutral anatomical stance, centered from head through feet with breathing room. Model shows realistic pale ivory skeleton/rib cage, subdued natural muscle detail partly visible, translucent torso context, heart and main vessels in natural restrained reds and blues, lungs muted natural rose. No gore, blood, mannequin/plastic, cartoon, primitive shapes, sexual emphasis or glowy hologram. Model render is a visual concept, not a clinical atlas. Natural soft medical-illustration studio lighting on charcoal. Heart selection has a delicate blue outline and ONE understated leader label "Tim", not many cluttered labels. Upper canvas left small readable plain text "Góc nhìn trước"; upper right unobtrusive axis/orientation control. Bottom center narrow charcoal toolbar with correctly recognizable outlined rotate/reset, zoom in, zoom out, labels, isolate and fullscreen controls, visible text for "Nhãn" and "Cô lập".
Right inspector: modest breadcrumb "Hệ tuần hoàn", large title "Tim", muted subtitle "Heart". Small readable tab row "Tổng quan" active, "Cấu trúc", "Hoạt động". Rather than fabricated medical facts or fake review badges, show precise design-state copy "Nội dung chuyên môn đang chờ kiểm duyệt." with calm neutral note. Below separated sections "Khám phá cấu trúc", three simple rows "Buồng tim", "Van tim", "Mạch máu"; blue main button "Xem hoạt động"; lower section "Nguồn & kiểm duyệt" with "Chưa có nội dung được xuất bản." No doctors' names, claims or statistics.
Bottom full-width subtle white review footer MUST be easily legible: "BẢN THIẾT KẾ • Hình giải phẫu minh họa bằng AI, chưa kiểm duyệt. Chưa phải mô hình 3D/4D hoạt động."
Extremely crisp typography, readable Vietnamese diacritics, clean column alignment, visually balanced purposeful composition. All controls and text are a concept reference to later implement as native web components, not a flattened production UI. Preserve the entire screen, do not crop.
mobile:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a fresh standalone MOBILE screen design for HumanScope, using the referenced desktop image ONLY as design-system reference: same white / royal blue #163cff / navy #111c35 panels, dark charcoal #151619 anatomy canvas, compact Inter-style Vietnamese typography, thin borders, small corner radii. This is not a crop of the desktop and not a phone photograph. Flat full-screen portrait 9:19.5, high resolution, no device bezel.
One usable mobile web primary screen: top white header simple blue H mark, HumanScope, VI, menu. A narrow mode line "Khám phá" and a search action. Main canvas full width, covering upper 60 percent of available height, a realistic full adult human anatomy render seen from front, feet and head inside canvas, skeleton and subdued internal anatomy with central heart selected with tiny blue outline. Neutral educational, not gore, hologram, plastic mannequin, cartoon or geometric body. Give sufficient margins above head/below feet and do not obstruct the heart. Canvas has one unobtrusive label "Tim"; top left "Toàn thân"; top right reset and full screen; bottom right plus/minus accessible touch controls stacked, 44px equivalent targets.
Bottom white sheet occupies lower third, with handle, back/close action, title "Tim" subtitle "Heart", segmented tabs "Tổng quan", "Cấu trúc", "Hoạt động". Active Tổng quan. Short clear note "Nội dung chuyên môn đang chờ kiểm duyệt." Primary full-width blue button "Xem hoạt động". Under it small link "Nguồn & kiểm duyệt". Bottom app action bar has THREE labels only: "Cấu trúc", "Thông tin" selected blue, "Hoạt động", with small simple outline icons. Thumb friendly, clean white safe area.
A legible two-line design review disclosure strip beneath bottom bar, exact text "BẢN THIẾT KẾ" and "Hình AI chưa kiểm duyệt • Chưa phải 3D/4D hoạt động". This is a VISUAL CONCEPT, not evidence of anatomical or medical accuracy. No clinical facts, fake doctors, verified badges, disease predictions or progression dates. Keep Vietnamese accents and labels crisp. Design thoughtful mobile composition with no three-column squeeze, no irrelevant stats or marketing content.
activity:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fresh high-resolution landscape desktop design screenshot of HumanScope's focused 4D anatomy activity viewer, not a crop of the reference. Use referenced desktop as design system authority: white #ffffff chrome, royal blue #163cff controls, navy #111c35 typography, hairline neutral borders, compact Inter-like Vietnamese labels, charcoal #151619 canvas. Entire complete desktop screen, 16:10 ratio. This is a proposed interaction design with AI illustration, not functioning medical software.
Top navigation consistent: H mark + HumanScope, "Khám phá" active, "Kiến thức", "Cơ sở y tế", "Học tập", VI, Đăng nhập. Below header left visible back button "Về toàn thân", breadcrumb "Hệ tuần hoàn / Tim / Hoạt động". No full left sidebar in focused view; canvas gets 70% width, white inspector 30%.
Canvas: one large exquisitely rendered anatomical HEART in natural muted rose-red/brown tissue with realistic organic shape, great vessels visible; no graphic gore, no neon veins, no valentines heart, no exaggerated whole-object pulse, no cartoon. Camera front three-quarter, soft studio lighting, generous charcoal negative space; subtle blue selection rim, no heavy glow. Small upper canvas text "Tim — xem riêng". At bottom left a SMALL unobtrusive whole-body orientation thumbnail in a charcoal frame showing selected chest region, labelled "Vị trí trong cơ thể"—a silhouette is permitted only for this secondary orientation minimap, never main anatomical model. Bottom right compact outline icons labelled "Nhãn", "Góc nhìn", "Đặt lại".
Right inspector: title "Hoạt động của tim"; tabs "Mô phỏng" active, "Chú thích". Below calm light gray notice with text "Thiết kế tương tác 4D" and "Chuyển động và nội dung cần được kiểm duyệt." Then title "Các giai đoạn", three numbered simple rows with the NONMEDICAL placeholder stage names "Giai đoạn 1", "Giai đoạn 2" selected blue, "Giai đoạn 3". Under row list small note "Tên và mốc giai đoạn sẽ theo mô phỏng được duyệt." A separated section "Chú thích đồng bộ" with text "Nội dung sẽ thay đổi theo vị trí trên timeline." Absolutely no BPM, cardiac timing, physiological claims, fake validation, disease prediction or unsupported measured values.
Along entire lower canvas width a meticulously designed WHITE playback strip ~130px tall, clearly separated from canvas: left pause button blue square plus text "Tạm dừng"; three-segment timeline with blue scrubber within segment 2, labels "01", "02", "03"; right "Tốc độ xem" then 0.5× / 1× / 2× selector (1× selected). Below line "Thanh thời gian minh họa tương tác, không biểu thị thời gian sinh lý." This is paused storyboard UI; do not depict multiple duplicated hearts as fake animation.
Bottom full width review footer exact readable text: "BẢN THIẾT KẾ • Hình AI chưa kiểm duyệt. Chưa có mô hình 4D hoạt động."
Design polished, calm, clean high craft product interface. Crisp readable short Vietnamese text, no huge pills, irrelevant cards, statistics, glowy sci-fi, promotional claims, browser or device frame.
